model_scope: Reduced-order system behavior model. It connects the BMS precharge/permission contract, the common BUS, two identical FOC branches, the independent regulator and 8S1P supercapacitor, and the pump auxiliary branch. It is not a switched power-stage or hardware qualification model.

frozen_configuration.battery_native_state: Current BMS schematic remains 9S4P with 3+3 main MOSFETs; 9S5P/130 A is not implemented or qualified.
frozen_configuration.dual_foc_peak_duration: Peak supply must cover launch from rest to 15 km/h. Elapsed time depends on the traction and supply qualification. The 1 s electrical pulse is a comparison interval.
frozen_configuration.regulator: Independent local controller and CAN; 8 LICAP SC0350-270-RSS in 8S1P; central 0.82 ohm dump path candidate/installed schematic value.
frozen_configuration.pump: 21 V brushed DC pump; about 3 A running is an input, not a startup/stall bound.
frozen_configuration.mechanical_screen: 30 kg and 15 km/h are project document comparison inputs, not an independently measured vehicle envelope.

not_frozen_thresholds: 76 mV is a TPS2490-candidate calculation input, not a released safety threshold
40.32 V and 38.63 V are nominal regulator comparator/hysteresis points, not a vehicle-level maximum-voltage envelope
2.0/2.2 V per supercap are comparison points, not released per-cell protections
unmodeled_external_boundaries: MPPT controller and its connection/gate state; 30 W is a bounded injection sensitivity only
vehicle main-controller auxiliary supply; startup and current envelope unspecified
pump motor winding, start/stall current and thermal behavior; no qualified motor model
battery internal resistance, current response, state/temperature dependence and bus wiring impedance
switching ripple, device delay, control-loop stability, component thermal/SOA and complete motor back-EMF trajectory
interpretation.model_behavior: In the rejected-charge calculation, two FOC branches inject equal halves of the single total mechanical comparison profile into one common BUS. The central dump is an ideal hysteretic power sink. The supercapacitor is behind an ideal bidirectional converter and is never counted as BUS bulk capacitance.
interpretation.qualification_rule: A favorable reduced-order result is MODEL_PASS_ONLY and remains HOLD for board/electrical/vehicle qualification whenever the source does not provide a guaranteed limit or topology is only a candidate.
